title: Docker build executor
description: Builds an image with docker buildx and explicitly loads or pushes the result.

file.description: Path to the Dockerfile. Supports {absWorkspaceRoot}, {absProjectRoot}, {projectName}, {env:NAME}, {gitSha}, {gitShortSha}, {gitBranch}, and {gitBranchTag} tokens.

context.description: Docker build context. Defaults to the Dockerfile directory and supports the same tokens as file.

image.description: Image repository without a tag or digest. Supports executor tokens.

tags.description: Image tags. Tokens are expanded before strict Docker tag validation.

immutableTags.description: Subset of selected push tags that must not be overwritten. Existing remote manifests are omitted from the build; only a confirmed missing manifest is published.

requireCleanWorktree.description: Reject tracked or untracked Git worktree changes before any Docker command runs.

buildArgs.description: Build arguments passed as separate --build-arg values without shell evaluation.

platforms.description: Target platforms in os/architecture[/variant] form. Load mode accepts at most one platform.

output.description: Uses --load for load mode or --push for push mode.

manifestFile.description: Optional path for a newline-delimited manifest of fully qualified image references, written only after success.
